This review found no defects at any severity. The new flag follows the project's `cli-flags` and `logging` rules, and tests exercise the exclusion branch: one pattern, several patterns, the empty default and the full archive run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag to `cli/main.py`. Files whose basename matches any of the patterns are skipped and logged at info level. The change also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds tests in `tests/test_main.py` and adds a text fixture at `tests/fixtures/hostile-review.txt`.
